title_en: Biku and the Missing Little Brother

character.name: Biku
character.description: Small white stickman, round white head, expressive black eyes, thin black arms and legs, bright red cape; same design across shots.

story: During the Rath Yatra, a young girl realises her little brother is missing. Biku listens, reassures her, and takes her to the official help point without leaving her alone. Volunteers follow the event's lost-child procedure, locate the boy and reunite the family. The story ends with a message about kindness and asking trusted helpers for help.

scenes.beat: Puri Rath Yatra opening; Biku enters the celebration
Biku notices a worried young girl
The girl explains that her little brother is missing
Biku suggests going to the official help point
They reach the event volunteers safely
Volunteers record the details and start the lost-child procedure
A volunteer team checks the designated search area
The younger brother is found safe with an event helper
Brother and sister reunite with their family
Biku's message about kindness, unity and Jai Jagannath

closing_line_or: ଆମେ ସମସ୍ତେ ଏକାଠି ହେଲେ କାହାକୁ ଏକା ରହିବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ ନାହିଁ।
safety: Trained staff handle chariot or lost-child procedures
